Authority order:
1. Tucker's explicit decisions
2. Accepted Foundation and canonical Library rules
3. Verified production evidence
4. Foundation recommendations
5. Watcher findings and prototypes

The watcher may observe, preserve minimum evidence, classify, and recommend.
It may not moderate, change blocks, contact members, publish policy, read private
content without explicit minimum-necessary authorization, change production, or
promote its own recommendation into canonical truth.
